In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the impact energy of rock-fall decreases as the impact radius increases,and the impact energy decreases with the increasing of impact velocity.The impact energy is proportional to the cube of impact velocity and the square of impact radius.The impact energy is also proportional to the square root of Young's modulus and inversely proportional to the density of slope materials.The impact energy of rockfall on slope is mainly concentrated in the upper part of slope,and decreases rapidly with the increase of depth.
the impact of rock-falls can be simulated by the elastic-plastic theory.
the elastic-plastic theory is more reasonable than the perfect elastic impact theory in the engineering design of slope rock-fall.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the rock-fall is a complex dynamic problem,so it is necessary to consider the effect of rock-fall impact velocity and radius on the dynamical responses of slope.
the impact energy is mainly absorbed by the rock-shed,while the energy absorbed by the slope is very little,which is helpful to the engineering design of slope protection.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the rockfall impact force is related to the impact velocity and the radius of rockfall.
the impact velocity and radius are two key parameters for the dynamical response and damage of slope under rock-fall impact.

the impact velocity and radius have a great influence on the deformation of slope,especially on the maximum displacement and the maximum shear strain of slope.The larger the impact velocity is,or the smaller the radius of rock-falls is, the more obvious the deformation of slope will be.
